function.name: _app_query_role_by_id
function.description: Query the full definition of an existing role in the current app by role key. Before calling, use _query_app_define_designer to get the real role identifier. In the returned permissionList, internal module ID permissions are converted to module key permissions, such as tableKey_TableQuery, for later _app_update_role calls.

id.description: Role identifier (role key), from roleList returned by _query_app_define_designer. Examples: tester, dataManager, workflowApprover.
